definition: M_i(<r)=4pi integral_0^r s^2 ds integral_0^1 rho_i(s sqrt(1−mu²),0,s mu) dmu, using reflection symmetry.
method: Gauss-Legendre independently in positive spherical shells. Disk angular variable uses mu=(.03/s)sinh(t) to resolve the equator. Monotonicity follows from nonnegative density and shell integrals; no clipping, cumulative max or visual smoothing.
normalization: Same density normalization and adopted masses recorded in model.json; no fitted parameters changed.
